statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-42011 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-6): permitted name constraints were ignored when the earlier CAs in a chain had only excluded name constraints (lib/x509/name_constraints.c), so certificate verification could bypass the name constraints. GnuTLS fixed it in 3.8.13 with commit 1dead2faec6320aaba321eb56f20d442df192b83: https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/1dead2faec6320aaba321eb56f20d442df192b83, https://gnutls.org/security-new.html, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/blob/3.8.14/NEWS . Alpine's 3.23-stable gnutls APKBUILD builds gnutls from the upstream release and lists CVE-2026-42011 under its 3.8.13-r0 security fixes: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/gnutls/APKBUILD . We downloaded every package built from the gnutls source in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository: gnutls, gnutls-c++, gnutls-dbg, gnutls-dev, gnutls-doc and gnutls-utils, each at 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0, 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 for x86_64 and aarch64, 48 apks, and checked each download against its index checksum; no gnutls package is published in the DHI Alpine security repository. The library code is in libgnutls.so.30 in the gnutls package; gnutls-c++ ships the C++ wrapper libgnutlsxx.so.30, the seven gnutls-utils programs list libgnutls.so.30 as a needed library, gnutls-dev ships headers, pkg-config data and the libgnutls.so and libgnutlsxx.so symbolic links and no static library, and gnutls-dbg ships debug symbols. The GnuTLS version string in libgnutls.so.30 reads 3.8.11, 3.8.12, 3.8.13 and 3.8.14 in the matching builds on both architectures. So 3.8.11-r0 and 3.8.12-r0 are affected and 3.8.13-r0 is the first fixed build; 3.8.14-r0 also carries the fix.

CVE-2026-42011: GnuTLS ignored permitted name constraints when earlier certificate authorities in the chain had only excluded name constraints, so certificate validation could accept a certificate that violates them. Upstream advisory GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-6 (https://www.gnutls.org/security-new.html#GNUTLS-SA-2026-04-29-6, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/work_items/1824) was fixed in GnuTLS 3.8.13 by https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/1dead2faec6320aaba321eb56f20d442df192b83. Debian fixed it for trixie in gnutls28 3.8.9-3+deb13u4 (DSA-6281-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-42011), which applies the 3.8.13 security patch set to 3.8.9. The only build of this owner currently published for Debian 13 is made from that Debian version; the changelog shipped in its libgnutls30t64 package on amd64 and arm64 records this CVE. The range ends at that build, the lowest published version carrying the fix. Builds made from Debian's earlier 3.8.9-3+deb13u2 and 3.8.9-3+deb13u3 sources sort below it and are reported as affected.
